execution_policy: Run duel then melee, one benchmark at a time; all agents confirmed no matches, compilers or sustained CPU probes. No source, maps, opponents, sample size or stopping-rule changes during acceptance. Preserve every fault and replay.
criterion: Each duel opponent separately requires strict observed wins above 80%; draws are nonwins; report all-game results, opponent-fault sensitivity floor and existing extra zero-fault/interval gates separately. N4 unique-first results reported separately.
seed_information_barrier: No acceptance seeds generated, read or used for tuning before this record.
